test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹9,900 at 9% per annum in 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹9,900

Rate (r) = 9% per annum

Time (t) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times r times t}{100} 

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{9,900 times 9 times 3}{100} 

⇒ SI = dfrac{267,300}{100} 

⇒ SI = ₹2,673

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
